name: CRM Integration

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: New connections start disabled. Enable after «Send test event» succeeds.

fields.label: Acts as user
fields.description: Events carry only what this user may read, and the connection's API calls use this user's API key. Use a dedicated user with only the roles the workflow needs.

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.description: Your n8n Webhook node's production URL. It must start with https://; for an n8n on your own network, ask support to allow its address.

fields.label: Signing secret
fields.description: Created automatically. Use «Show signing secret» to copy it into n8n.

fields.label: Skip changes this connection made
fields.description: Record and document events are not sent for changes made with this connection's own user, so a flow that writes back does not trigger itself.

fields.label: Inbox channel
fields.description: Optional. Lets this connection bring messages from another channel (email, SMS, Telegram…) into the CRM inbox. Replies written in the inbox leave as message.created events with direction «out».

fields.label: Channel account
fields.description: Stable identifier of this inbox channel; created when the channel is first enabled.

description: A connection to n8n or another automation service: signed webhook events out, scoped API calls in.
